name: Dadi Kingdom
storyline: You wear the crown of Dadi Kingdom. Each day, new cases are brought before your throne: thieves, cheats, the falsely accused. You decide between release, a gold fine or the dungeon, and every verdict follows you through the realm. Beyond the castle walls the kingdom waits: the Far Lands across the sea, the cathedral of Sanktum, the desert bastion, the pirate bay, the ash forests and the mage ruins of Thyrn. Stone golems, lizardmen and dark mages guard these places. You will not rule forever. Father an heir before your time runs out and leave behind a dynasty worth remembering.
summary:
You are the king. Pass judgment on your people, ride into your own realm sword in hand, and decide who hands you the power to do it. You will not rule forever. Father an heir before your time runs out, and leave behind a dynasty worth remembering.

Dadi Kingdom is a medieval action RPG where you rule and fight. Every day new cases land before your throne: release, gold fine or dungeon. Your verdicts follow you. Outside the walls, the kingdom waits: the Far Lands, the cathedral of Sanktum, the desert bastion, the pirate bay, the ash forests and the mage ruins of Thyrn. Stone golems, lizardmen and dark mages stand in your way.
